reports.title: Lake Nacimiento dropped to 32 percent of its storage capacity
reports.text: Fishing held up for another week, with spotted bass still rising to topwater baits, although the better action came below the surface with drop-shot rigs and reaction baits. Kastmasters, Hopkins spoons, and tail spinners worked well for white bass and also produced spotted bass. Crappie responded to mini jigs, swimbaits, and live minnows, while catfish were caught on cut mackerel, sardines, and chicken liver.

reports.title: Fishing remained fair at Hart Park
reports.text: Fishing remained fair at Hart Park, with largemouth bass taking Texas rigs, creature baits, and Senkos in darker colors. Crankbaits also produced a few bass.

reports.title: Bass fishing at Ming Lake remains fair to good
reports.text: Bass fishing at Ming Lake remains fair to good, with several quality fish reported this week. Larger bass are being caught on 5- to 7-inch soft plastic swimbaits, while the reaction bite has been producing fish on chatterbaits, spinnerbaits, and lipless crankbaits worked along the grass lines and deeper edges. Early mornings and late afternoons have been the most productive, with shad-patterned baits getting the most attention. Anglers are also finding success slowing down with Texas-rigged plastics and finesse jigs when the reaction bite slows. Crappie fishing remains fair, with small live shiners and mini jigs producing occasional fish around deeper structure. Bluegill continue to bite…

reports.title: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to improve
reports.text: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to improve, with anglers reporting the best action during the early morning and late afternoon hours.

reports.title: The fall bass bite slowed slightly but still producing quality fish
reports.text: Lake Isabella held steady this week at 24 percent of capacity, with the fall bass bite slowing slightly but still producing quality fish. Crappie fishing remains fair but has slowed, requiring anglers to put in more effort to get bites.

reports.title: Striped bass were best targeted with cut sardines in 30 to 90 feet of water
reports.text: Largemouth and smallmouth bass were caught on deep-diving crankbaits until sunlight reached the water, after which most anglers switched to brown jigs and drop-shot rigs.

reports.title: The lake was in a definite transition period this week
reports.text: Large and smallmouth were best targeted near 20 feet deep with a slow drop shot presentation using stickbaits in cinnamon, green pumpkin, and brown colors. Stripped bass appeared to be holding in 35 to 50 feet of water on the bottom in the middle of coves.
